    count_input = int(input())
    times_list = [int(input()) for _ in range(count_input)]
    T_value = int(input())

    times_list.sort()
    max_items = 1
    for start_idx in range(count_input):
        for end_idx in range(start_idx, count_input):
            if times_list[end_idx] - times_list[start_idx] > T_value:
                break
            max_items = max(max_items, end_idx - start_idx + 1)
    print(max_items)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
